quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: A large truck ahead of you is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. The truck:

options.text: May complete its turn in either of the two lanes.
May need to swing wide to complete the right turn.
Must stay in the right lane at all times while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: May need to swing wide to complete the right turn.
questions.explanation: When a vehicle turns, the rear wheels follow a shorter path than the front wheels. Long trucks need more space to turn. They often swing wide to complete a right turn safely.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.correctAnswerText: Red, yellow, green.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers that a traffic light is coming up at an intersection.

questions.question: To avoid skidding on slippery surfaces, you should:

options.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up to enter curves and slow down to exit them.
Slow down before entering curves and intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering curves and intersections.
questions.explanation: Slow down before you enter a curve because you cannot see what is ahead. Braking while in a curve can cause you to skid.

questions.question: If you need your lights on due to weather or low light while driving, use:
questions.correctAnswerText: Your low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, snow, or rain. High beam light reflects back and creates glare, making it harder to see.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. It warns that children or pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: A broken yellow centerline means:

options.text: You can pass on the right when the way ahead is clear.
You can pass on the left when the way ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when the way ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline allows you to cross and pass on the left if no traffic is coming. Never cross a solid yellow centerline to pass.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right ahead.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right ahead.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn about upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: To avoid losing traction on wet roads, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Lower your speed on wet roads and keep your tires in good condition to prevent hydroplaning. If you lose control, release the gas, do not brake, keep the vehicle straight, and let it slow down naturally.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: Drivers must obey instructions from:

options.text: Other drivers whose vehicles are broken down on the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Flaggers (signal persons) at construction sites.
questions.explanation: Drivers must obey flaggers at construction sites. Flaggers help keep drivers and workers safe.

questions.question: If your car's rear is skidding to the left, you should:

options.text: Turn your steering wheel to the left.
Turn your steering wheel to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel to the left.
questions.explanation: If you skid, turn your steering wheel in the direction the rear is skidding. Take your foot off the gas and avoid using the brakes. If you have anti-lock brakes, apply them firmly and steer straight.

questions.question: You hit a parked car and can't find the owner. What should you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the car.
questions.explanation: You must leave a note with your name, phone number, and address attached to any vehicle or property you hit.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly blows out while driving, you should:

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of traffic.
Brake hard and steer toward the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of traffic.
questions.explanation: Stay calm during a blowout. Grip the steering wheel firmly and release the gas pedal to let the car slow down. Apply light brakes once the car has slowed. Don't move to the shoulder until the car is going slowly.

questions.question: Traffic control devices in construction zones are what color?
questions.correctAnswerText: Orange.
questions.explanation: Orange signs, cones, and barriers mark work zones. Drive carefully when you see orange warnings on the road.

questions.question: You are driving behind a motorcycle and want to pass. You must:

options.text: Stay in the right lane since the motorcycle is small and doesn't use all the space.
Blow your horn to make the motorcycle move to the shoulder.
Keep your vehicle fully in the left lane before and during the pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your vehicle fully in the left lane before and during the pass.
questions.explanation: Give motorcycles a full lane when passing. Never share the lane with a motorcycle. Returning to the original lane too soon can force a rider to swerve and crash.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending and they need to prepare to merge.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Stay farther back from the car in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther back from the car in front of you.
questions.explanation: In poor visibility or darkness, increase your distance from other cars. Extra space gives you more time to react to dangers you may not see coming.

questions.question: A truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right. You should:

options.text: Turn quickly before the truck or bus turns.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This causes serious crashes. Wait for the truck or bus to finish turning before you turn.

questions.question: If a tire blows out while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Press the brake hard and hold it.
Hold the steering wheel tight and brake gently.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tight and brake gently.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, hold the steering wheel tight to keep the car straight. Slow down gradually by taking your foot off the gas and using light braking. Do not stop on the road. Drive to a safe place and pull off.

questions.question: What does a steady green traffic light mean?

options.text: You can go through if it is safe and the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can go through if it is safe and the intersection is clear.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can go through the intersection. First, check that traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection have cleared. Then proceed at a safe speed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road conditions. This sign warns that traffic from the right will merge ahead. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way road and entering a road where traffic goes both directions.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Slow down and stop if needed before entering the intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad ahead.
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: If you are getting tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: Tired driving is dangerous. Take a break every hour on long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so each of you can rest.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of an intersection ahead so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: If your car has a two-part seat belt, what should you do?

options.text: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: Always wear both parts of a two-part seat belt system. Using only one part does not protect you well. Buckle both the lap belt and shoulder belt.

questions.question: Which statement about alcohol and driving is true?

options.text: If you can walk straight, it is safe to drive after drinking.
Driving is safe if you are below the legal alcohol limit.
Alcohol hurts your judgment, which you need to drive safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol hurts your judgment, which you need to drive safely.
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your judgment. Good judgment is needed to react quickly and correctly while driving. Even small amounts of alcohol can reduce your driving ability, even if you are below the legal limit.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spot when changing lanes?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Mirrors alone cannot show blind spots. Before changing lanes, look over your shoulder to see these areas that mirrors cannot show.

questions.question: When should you drive at the maximum posted speed limit?
questions.correctAnswerText: Under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit is the fastest speed allowed only when conditions are perfect. Drive safely and match the speed of traffic around you, but never exceed the posted limit. All drivers must drive at safe speeds.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic going both ways.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information and distances to locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Motorist services.
questions.explanation: Blue signs show where motorist services are available. These include rest areas, food, gas stations, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep grade ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. These signs alert drivers to watch for animals, people, and bicycles that may cross the road.
